subject.title: Dashboard: shared vs private tabs + role/scope-gated visibility

question: Should dashboard tab visibility be enforced as per-tab shared/private metadata in the dashboard plugin store, as existing connection-wide plugin-tab `requiredScopes`, or deferred until the Wave 1 dashboard substrate lands?
rationale: The request changes privacy/security semantics for a not-yet-merged dashboard surface, so automation cannot choose the durable role/scope model without maintainer intent.

options.title: Gate in dashboard store after substrate lands
options.body: Implement per-tab visibility and role/scope filtering in the dashboard plugin's schema, store reads/writes, and UI lists after the base dashboard PRs are accepted.

options.title: Use only connection-wide scopes
options.body: Keep visibility at the existing plugin-tab descriptor level, which avoids new per-tab policy but does not solve private tabs inside a shared dashboard.

options.title: Defer the multi-user layer
options.body: Leave this roadmap item open but do not implement it until maintainers approve the broader multi-operator dashboard model.

recommendation.title: Gate in dashboard store after substrate lands
recommendation.body: Implement per-tab visibility and role/scope filtering in the dashboard plugin's schema, store reads/writes, and UI lists after the base dashboard PRs are accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: The current shipped Control UI plugin-tab seam was introduced through their merged Logbook PR, and this decision crosses that seam plus security/product policy.
